retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of HydroATLAS version 1 and its BasinATLAS, RiverATLAS and LakeATLAS sub-datasets. No vector/database bytes were acquired.
intended_use: Global hydrographic and hydro-environmental reference for catchment, river-network, lake, upstream-context and cross-peril hydrology research. HydroATLAS is contextual geography/attributes and not a discharge observation, inundation footprint or catastrophe event catalogue.

licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide CC BY 4.0 attribution and the requested HydroATLAS/HydroSHEDS scientific citations applicable to the selected sub-dataset.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: CC BY 4.0 permits adaptation without a share-alike requirement; attribution and indication of changes remain required.
licensing.notes: The authoritative HydroATLAS page licenses the HydroATLAS database under CC BY 4.0. HydroSHEDS hosts other products with product-specific licences; this admission must not be generalized to the entire HydroSHEDS catalogue.

redistribution.conditions: HydroATLAS version 1 source rights support redistribution under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only and has not selected an exact BasinATLAS, RiverATLAS or LakeATLAS artifact.

privacy.notes: The reviewed product is public global hydrographic geometry and aggregated hydro-environmental attributes.

spatial.extent: Global sub-basins, river reaches and lakes; exact geometry resolution and CRS depend on the selected HydroATLAS sub-dataset/distribution

temporal.extent: HydroATLAS version 1 compiled reference attributes with heterogeneous upstream source periods; not an event time series

variables_and_units.name: hydrographic geometry
variables_and_units.description: Sub-basin polygons, river-reach lines and lake polygons in BasinATLAS, RiverATLAS and LakeATLAS respectively.

variables_and_units.name: hydro-environmental attributes
variables_and_units.description: 56 variables partitioned into 281 attributes across hydrology, physiography, climate, land cover/use, soils/geology and anthropogenic-influence categories; units are attribute-specific.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval for HydroATLAS version 1 specifically. Future raw work must select the exact sub-dataset, level/resolution and file identity, preserve attribute definitions/units and upstream-source semantics, and avoid inheriting this licence decision to other HydroSHEDS products.
